a.text: Being upfront: with a 75% storm chance after every round, the original plan almost guarantees that both of us fail. We'd need 3+ rounds with no storm, which is about a 1.5% chance. So I'm proposing a change rather than breaking the deal silently. Only one of us can reach 4 from the current reserve. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every remaining round and never take again, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If you'd rather argue for a different split, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round, so I'm openly breaking the original agreement. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take again, so all generated cells can go to you. Please operate too. The generator only runs if we both do.
